entities.summary: Gaetano Gaspari was an Italian composer, bibliographer, and historian of music. He composed mainly liturgical music, including the Offertorium of the Messa per Rossini. He studied with Benedetto Donelli at the Liceo Musicale in Bologna from 1820 to 1827, where he won first prizes in piano and counterpoint. He simultaneously served as the organist at San Martino, Bologna from 1824 to 1827. From 1828 to 1836, he was conductor of the municipal orchestra and maestro di cappella of the Collegiata at Pieve di Cento.
